system.description: This accessory is installed on search-and-rescue Droids sent to recover pilots who bailout during combat. The small oxygen tank attached to the Droid's torso provides enough oxygen for a creature of Medium size for 30 minutes. The tank can be used to recharge a Vacuum Pod's supply, or the oxygen can be administered through a Breath Mask attached to the tank. Connecting the supply to a Vacuum Pod is a Swift Action. Securing the Breath Mask is a Standard Action.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
